abstract: OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the safety, ovarian function preservation, reproductive ability, and the emotional attitude after a conservative surgery for ovarian cancer. METHODS: This is a retrospective study of women conservatively treated for primary ovarian cancer between January 2000 and December 2010 at King Abdulaziz University Hospital, Jeddah, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Patient's charts were reviewed for pathology, stage, requirement of adjuvant chemotherapy, and recurrent, as well as menstrual history, and pregnancy after treatment. During follow up the patients were asked 3 questions about their emotional attitude toward their disease. RESULTS: There were 39 patients identified (mean age 22 years). Thirty-one (80%) patients were presented with stage I and 20 (52%) were Germ cell tumor. Fifteen (39%) patients received initial chemotherapy after primary surgery. Three (8%) patients had recurrent. Thirty-eight (98%) patients retuned to a regular menstruation after treatment. Eight patients (20%) had a normal pregnancy. Of the respondents to the given questions, 10 (44%) patients claimed that their disease did not have any impact on their desire to have children and 12 patients (52%) feared that their ovarian disease could have damage in their reproductive potential. Only 9 patients (39%) had no concerned about the effect of the treatment they received on the offspring. CONCLUSION: Fertility sparing surgery in ovarian cancer appears to be safe, and a practical treatment option in selected cases with ovarian cancer diagnosis. Most patients can have ovarian preservation after treatment and should not be discouraged from getting pregnant.
abstract_ja: 目的：卵巣癌に対する保存的手術後の安全性、卵巣機能温存、妊孕性、および心理的態度を評価すること。方法：本研究は後方視的研究であり、2000年1月から2010年12月の間に、サウジアラビア王国ジェッダのKing Abdulaziz University Hospitalで原発性卵巣癌に対して保存的治療を受けた女性を対象とした。診療録を参照し、病理、病期、補助化学療法の必要性、再発、月経歴、治療後の妊娠を調査した。フォローアップ中、患者には病気に対する心理的態度について3つの質問を行った。結果：39例が同定された（平均年齢22歳）。31例（80%）が病期I、20例（52%）が胚細胞腫瘍であった。15例（39%）が初回手術後に化学療法を受けた。3例（8%）で再発がみられた。38例（98%）が治療後に規則的な月経に戻った。8例（20%）が正常分娩に至った。質問への回答者のうち、10例（44%）は病気が子どもを持ちたい希望に影響しなかったと答え、12例（52%）は卵巣疾患が生殖能力を損なうのではないかと懸念していた。9例（39%）のみが、受けた治療の子どもへの影響について懸念していなかった。結論：卵巣癌における妊孕性温存手術は安全であり、選択された症例において実行可能な治療選択肢と思われる。ほとんどの患者は治療後に卵巣機能を温存でき、妊娠を希望することを思いとどまらせるべきではない。
